audit_items.proof_trace: The pre-condition is enforced by the assert at line 197: `self.cash - self.cash_reserve.ceil() > amount`. The single normal-borrow call chain is `borrow::borrow() → market::handle_borrow() → reserve::borrow_amount()` (confirmed by grep); no alternative borrow path bypasses this check. Using `ceil()` on `cash_reserve` makes the guard strictly more conservative than the property requires, and `withdraw_underlying` provides a secondary backstop asserting `cash >= cash_reserve.ceil()` post-withdrawal. If `cash_reserve.ceil() > cash` (extreme-utilisation edge case), the subtraction aborts the transaction, still preventing the borrow — the security invariant holds in all reachable states.
